title: Reposition 1: vocabulary, statuses, dimensions and tagline
description:
Decided with the product owner on 2026-10-22: Shipped moves from a board of verdicts to a living map in three layers (signals, the map, AI-written stories), steered by signed-in readers, with editors able to override them. Phase 1 ships everything that needs no new Papyrus feature.

Do it before reader sign-in opens (ship-63b07d), while no reader ratings exist, so no reader data needs migrating.

Design: https://claude.ai/artifact/EoXGtpzsayij4d7tmrfZ9r (round 2 delivered; round 3 pending).
